title: Make it clearer that you can click on items to copy them
line: Hovering an entry in the clipboard popup now shows a tooltip saying that clicking it copies it.
explanation: Clipboard history entries copy themselves when clicked, but nothing in the popup says so: hovering an entry only shows the star, edit, QR code and remove buttons, so people looking for a copy action hunt through those buttons. The change gives each entry a tooltip, "Click to copy to the clipboard", shown after the usual tooltip delay while the pointer rests on the entry itself (not on its tool buttons, which keep their own tooltips, and not while dragging).

commits.message:
klipper: show a tooltip saying that clicking an entry copies it

Nothing in the clipboard popup told people that clicking an entry copies
it, so some went looking for a copy button among the tool buttons. Show
a tooltip with that hint when hovering an entry outside its buttons.

BUG: 453821

patches.diff:
From 18299e242687bd2c2be74bfd0a132bfdb202b418 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 23:56:08 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] klipper: show a tooltip saying that clicking an entry copies
 it

Nothing in the clipboard popup told people that clicking an entry copies
it, so some went looking for a copy button among the tool buttons. Show
a tooltip with that hint when hovering an entry outside its buttons.

BUG: 453821
---
 klipper/declarative/qml/ClipboardItemDelegate.qml | 4 ++++
 1 file changed, 4 insertions(+)

diff --git a/klipper/declarative/qml/ClipboardItemDelegate.qml b/klipper/declarative/qml/ClipboardItemDelegate.qml
index 58df3a6008..3a1719a3c6 100644
--- a/klipper/declarative/qml/ClipboardItemDelegate.qml
+++ b/klipper/declarative/qml/ClipboardItemDelegate.qml
@@ -97,6 +97,10 @@ PlasmaComponents.ItemDelegate {
 
     onHoveredChanged: if (hovered) ListView.view.currentIndex = index
 
+    PlasmaComponents.ToolTip.text: i18nd("klipper", "Click to copy to the clipboard")
+    PlasmaComponents.ToolTip.delay: Kirigami.Units.toolTipDelay
+    PlasmaComponents.ToolTip.visible: hovered && !dragHandler.active && !(toolButtonsLoader.item as DelegateToolButtons)?.hovered
+
     // The highlight at a listview level is disabled as by default Listview then scrolls to keep that index in view
     // see https://bugs.kde.org/show_bug.cgi?id=387797
     // Instead place highlight in each delegate and we don't keep the highlight in view
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Hovering an entry: only the tool buttons appear, nothing says that clicking copies it
Hovering an entry now shows "Click to copy to the clipboard"
Hovering a tool button still shows only its own tooltip; the hint also works on the top entry and on image entries
